The adapter and the R3 ingest both query only hazards.fema.gov/arcgis/rest/services/public/NFHL/MapServer/28 ('Flood Hazard Zones', S_FLD_HAZ_AR). That layer DOES carry a STATIC_BFE attribute field (confirmed in the layer-28 field probe) -- R3's finding that it is <1% populated is a true statement about that one layer, not evidence BFE is externally unavailable. The SAME MapServer service (same base URL, zero new auth, zero cost) also serves layer 16 'Base Flood Elevations' (S_BFE, polyline, real ELEV values) and layer 3 'FIRM Panels' (S_FIRM_PAN, polygon, EFF_DATE field) -- neither ever queried. Layer 3 is polygon geometry, so the existing point-on-surface/point-in-polygon join already proven for zone determination (R3's reconciliation rule) applies unchanged to get a panel effective date per parcel; no new join logic needed for that gap. Layer 16 (elevation lines) needs a different join (nearest-line, not containment) -- a real but bounded scope addition.
